name: net_desynced_seat_of_three_is_outvoted
description: Three seats. A bug writes client 3's lives down to 1: its hashes part from the others (a minority: here the sequencer keeps M1's referee, which only logs it; M4 resyncs it, net_minority_desync_resyncs) and its Holdfast falls early, so it sends RESULT(lost) long before the others. Clients 1 and 2 agree, run past that tick and play on; their agreed RESULT at the real end decides (design 6.7). With two seats the same would end 'desynced'.

steps.msg: the minority's hashes were logged, and ended nothing

steps.assert: scene.seq.seat_conn(2)['result'][0] == minority_end and scene.tick(1) > minority_end and scene.tick(2) > minority_end
steps.msg: client 3 claimed its end; the majority ran past it and plays on

steps.assert: scene.seq.outcome == 'lost' and scene.seq.end_reason == 'result' and scene.seq.final_tick > minority_end
steps.msg: the majority's RESULT ended the match at its own final tick

steps.assert: scene.client(1).outcome == 'lost' and scene.client(3).outcome == 'lost' and scene.client(3).final_tick == scene.seq.final_tick
scene.tick(1) == scene.tick(2) and scene.hash_hex(1) == scene.hash_hex(2) and scene.seq.final_tick == scene.tick(1)
steps.msg: the majority stopped together in the same state
